title: Image Downsampling Math
hints: Memory = pixels × 4 bytes, regardless of the JPEG's file size.
Aspect-fill: the scale factor is the larger of the two ratios, capped at 1.
Round the thumbnail dimensions up to whole pixels.
jsBridge: Decoded image memory is width × height × 4 bytes, whatever the JPEG's file size. Downsampling to display size with ImageIO before decoding is the iOS version of serving `srcset`-sized images on the web, except the device must do it.

compass.q: On the web, `srcset` asks the server for the right size. What's the iOS equivalent when you only have the full-size photo?
Why multiply display points by screen scale (@2x/@3x) before downsampling?
